body:
Surveyed the 5 priority-queue SIP-phone cards' overlapping ask. Found: PJSIP registration, provisioning, QR onboarding, and the Android app's real SIP/RTP/DTMF/G.711 code are all confirmed working. The one unverified link: no real end-to-end call has ever been witnessed. Built sudo-queue/74-ami-call-monitor.sh (real, live AMI event narration) to close that gap the next time the founder places a test call. MONOREPO commit 02ebce8.

⚓ ☃
title: CarePyre SIP phone real-state survey + live AMI call monitor
